source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The root modules (EKS cluster, Kubernetes services, Postgres, backups) compose reusable building blocks from the _sub folder: cluster, node groups, network, Flux and IAM. Terragrunt deploys the whole in test/integration and Go tests verify the resulting cluster.
